name: Lantern Row Books
tagline: An online bookstore for new, used and hard-to-find books.
summary: Lantern Row Books is a fictional 15-person online bookstore. It sells new and second-hand books through a hosted web shop and ships them from a small rented warehouse. Most of the team works on company laptops, some from home, and everyone shares one email and file system.
data: Customer names, email addresses and shipping addresses
Order history and wish lists for about 40,000 customer accounts
systems: A hosted web shop (the storefront and customer accounts)
A payment processor, so card numbers never touch our own systems
Shared cloud email, calendar and file storage
Accounting software used by the two-person finance team
12 staff laptops and one warehouse PC that prints shipping labels
